prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: transparent full-body spectral apparition cutout to be composited as an ethereal figure inside a photorealistic first-person Chinese ghost-story game inspired by Liaozhai. One ordinary Chinese woman in her mid thirties, a wronged wandering spirit, early Qing / late Ming commoner's appearance, long slightly unkempt black hair with a loose plain cloth tie, no elaborate jewelry or fantasy crown. Modest weathered face with natural asymmetry, tired sorrowful eyes, one cheek partly veiled by a strand of hair; recognizably human and mournful, quietly unsettling, NOT a glamorous beautiful ghost. Worn undyed off-white cross-collared cotton robe and layered long skirt, long loose sleeves, small faded blue cloth belt, bare pale hands. Stands upright in a restrained three-quarter-front view, chin slightly lowered, eyes looking toward the viewer, one hand held open as if asking someone to listen, other hand holding a narrow torn strip of old cloth. Whole head, both hands, entire long robe and hem visible with ample transparent margin. Slightly floating hem softly dissolving into a few wisps, mostly solid body so the game controls translucency. Photoreal cinematic game character, realistic facial anatomy and skin texture, convincing folds and woven cotton detail, restrained cold desaturated palette with very subtle warm lantern light on one sleeve, gentle edge light for readability in a dark room. True transparent alpha background, no room, no floor, no background gradient, no scenery, no backdrop, no cast ground shadow, no surrounding large fog cloud. Portrait 1024x1536. No text, no watermark, no blood, no gore, no exposed wounds, no monstrous teeth, no white glowing eyeballs, no modern dress, no Japanese kimono, no anime, no illustration outlines, no stylized plastic 3D, no jump-scare scream pose.
